title: Knock, knock! / everyone, something, nothing ...
subtitle: 敲敲门 / 每个人、某物、没有什么……

lead.question: 去朋友家做客，敲门却没人应——「家里没有人吗？」「我能看见什么吗？」「什么也看不见」「大家都在花园里」——这些带 anyone/nothing/everyone 的句子该怎么说？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象你和同伴去朋友家赴午宴：敲门没人应，再敲还是安静。你趴窗往里看——Can you see anything? — Nothing at all. 正要放弃时，改敲后门，却发现 Everyone's in the garden! 这里的主角是复合不定代词：some-（某）、any-（任何，用于疑问/否定）、no-（没有）、every-（每个）。它们都当单数用。先试着把「有人吗」「一个人也没有」各说一遍，再听海伦和吉姆的敲门记。第 116 课把 nothing/no one/nowhere 与 something/everything 铺开操练。
goals: 掌握复合不定代词 something/anything/nothing/everything 与 someone/anyone/no one/everyone 的用法
会用 didn't ... anything = ... nothing 互换否定说法
能用 Everyone's + v-ing 描述大家正在做什么
学会 knock at the door / look through the window 等动作表达
lead.summary: 第 115 课海伦和吉姆应卡罗尔和汤姆之邀来吃午饭，前门敲了又敲却毫无动静。吉姆断定家里没有人，海伦不信——趴窗一看，什么也看不见。改走后门才发现：大家都想在暖洋洋的花园里吃午饭！第 116 课操练：I did nothing / I saw no one / I went nowhere；Everyone's looking out of the window；I've got nothing to eat 等。
lead.tips: ① 复合不定代词都作单数：Everyone's in the garden.（注意 's 不是复数）；② something 用于肯定句，anything 用于疑问句和否定句，nothing 本身含否定；③ didn't hear anything = heard nothing，两种说法等价；④ -one 与 -body 系列指人（anyone/anybody），-thing 系列指物；⑤ Everything's very quiet. 四周很安静；Nothing at all. 什么也没有（加强语气）；⑥ knock at the door 敲门；look through the window 透过窗看。

questions.q: Why doesn't anyone answer the door at first?
questions.zh: 为什么起初没有人来开门？
questions.a: Because everyone is in the garden having lunch — it's nice and warm out there, so they don't hear the knock at the front door.
questions.aZh: 因为大家都暖洋洋地在花园里吃午饭呢，根本没听见敲前门。
questions.hint: 答案在课文的后半段，吉姆从后门看到了什么。

questions.q: Why is Helen sure there must be someone at home?
questions.zh: 海伦为什么确信家里一定有人？
questions.a: Because Carol and Tom invited them to lunch.
questions.aZh: 因为卡罗尔和汤姆请他们来吃午饭。
questions.hint: 听 But that's impossible. 之后那句。

questions.q: What can Jim see when he looks through the window?
questions.zh: 吉姆透过窗户能看见什么？
questions.hint: 听 Can you see anything? 的回答。

questions.q: Where does everyone want to have lunch?
questions.a: In the garden — it's nice and warm out there.
questions.aZh: 在花园里——外面天气好又暖和。

questions.q: Why do we say 'Everyone's in the garden' with 's, not 'Everyone are'?
questions.zh: 为什么说 Everyone's in the garden 而不说 Everyone are？
questions.a: Everyone/everybody/something/nothing 等复合不定代词在语法上都按第三人称单数处理。
questions.aZh: everyone/everybody/something/nothing 等复合不定代词在语法上都按第三人称单数处理，be 动词用 is（'s）。
questions.hint: 中文的「大家」看着像复数，英文按单数。

questions.q: No, I didn't hear anything. I heard nothing. / Everyone's ___-ing. / I've got nothing to ___.
questions.zh: 第 116 课操练：didn't ... anything = ... nothing；Everyone's + 现在分词；nothing/something to do。
questions.a: No, I didn't buy anything. I bought nothing. / Everyone's hurrying to work. / No, I haven't got anything to read. I've got nothing to read.
questions.aZh: 不，我没买任何东西，我什么也没买。/ 大家都赶着去上班。/ 不，我没什么可读的。
questions.hint: anything 句式换成 nothing 时，动词改肯定式。

drill.q: No, I didn't ___ anything. I ___ nothing. / Everyone's ___-ing. / No, I haven't got anything to ___. I've got nothing to ___.
drill.zh: 不，我没……任何……，我什么也没……。/ 大家都在……。/ 不，我没什么可……的。（anything/nothing 互换与 everyone 作单数）

exercises.note: 否定疑问句，比 Is there anyone...? 更带惊讶语气。

grammar.title: 复合不定代词 something / anything / nothing / everything
grammar.structure: some-（肯定句）/ any-（疑问、否定句）/ no-（本身含否定）/ every- + -thing（指物）
grammar.definition: -thing 系列指物，都按第三人称单数处理；something 用于肯定句，anything 用于疑问句和否定句，nothing = not anything；no- 系列本身含否定，动词用肯定式。
grammar.usage: Come and have something to drink. / Can you see anything? / Nothing at all.

grammar.title: 指人的复合不定代词 someone / anyone / no one / everyone
grammar.structure: -one 与 -body 系列指人，意义相同，均作单数
grammar.definition: someone/somebody 某人，anyone/anybody 任何人（疑问、否定），no one/nobody 没有人，everyone/everybody 每个人。都作单数：Everyone's here. Everybody wants ...
grammar.usage: Isn't there anyone at home? / I'm sure there's no one at home.

examples.en: Everybody wants to have lunch in the garden.
examples.zh: 大家都想在花园里吃午饭。

grammar.title: anything 与 nothing 的句式互换
grammar.structure: didn't + 动词 + anything = 动词过去式 + nothing
grammar.definition: 表示「什么也没……」有两种等价说法：否定句用 not ... anything（didn't hear anything），或肯定动词 + nothing（heard nothing）。注意英语中一个句子里不叠用两个否定。
grammar.usage: No, I didn't buy anything. I bought nothing.

examples.en: I didn't go anywhere. I went nowhere.
I haven't got anything to do. I've got nothing to do.
Carol and Tom invited us to lunch.
examples.zh: 卡罗尔和汤姆请我们来吃午饭。

examples.en: Can you see anything? — Nothing at all.
examples.zh: 你能看见什么吗？——什么也看不见。

phrases.usage: 很好很暖和（nice and 修饰形容词，加强语气）

examples.en: It's nice and warm out here.
Come and have something to drink.
